items.title: "SpudCell will replicate continuously by 2030" | Kate Adamala
items.one_liner:
SpudCell is a synthetic phospholipid liposome that can ingest nutrients, grow, and divide for at least five generations, but it is not considered alive because it lacks the robustness to replicate continuously; the authors argue that with further engineering it could achieve perpetual replication by ~2030 and thereby expand life’s chemistry, enable new medicines, and help biologize the economy.

METHOD / APPROACH:
- Constructed a two‑component phospholipid liposome as the cell membrane.
